_about: Minted film records merged into the film they duplicate, written by scripts/scrape_programs.py (film_identity.detect_duplicates). 'merged': dropped id -> {into: kept id, rule, reason, since, record: the dropped record}. The dropped record's titles keep resolving to the kept film, the page maps the old id through FILM_REDIRECT and film/<old id>/ stays a share page of the kept film, so links already shared keep working. To undo a wrong merge, list the pair under 'distinct' in scripts/film_aliases.json: the next run restores the record and never merges the pair again.
